description: End-to-end workflow for managing email infrastructure, templates, audiences, campaigns, sending, tracking, and error recovery on a CPaaS/TaaS email API platform.

sender_id.description: Unique identifier for a verified sender identity (domain or from-address profile).

template_id.description: Unique identifier for an email content template.

segment_id.description: Unique identifier for an audience segment.

campaign_id.description: Unique identifier for an email campaign.

batch_id.description: Unique identifier for a send batch within a campaign.

message_id.description: Unique identifier for an individual email message.

webhook_id.description: Unique identifier for a webhook subscription.

email_recipient.description: Represents an email recipient with optional metadata and preferences.

metadata.description: Key-value metadata for personalization or attribution.

functions.name: register_sender_identity
functions.description: Register and verify a sender identity (domain or from-address profile) for sending emails.

type.description: Type of sender identity to register.

domain.description: Domain to be used for sending (required when type=domain).

from_address.description: Specific from email address (required when type=from_address).

display_name.description: Human-friendly display name for the sender.

include_mechanism.description: Mechanism string to be added to SPF record, if applicable.

verification_callback.description: Optional webhook callback for verification events.

functions.returns: Sender identity record including sender_id, DNS instructions for DKIM/SPF, and verification status.

functions.name: get_sender_status
functions.description: Retrieve status and health metrics for a sender identity, including verification and reputation.

include_metrics.description: Whether to include reputation and delivery metrics.

functions.returns: Sender identity details with verification status, reputation scores, and optional metric aggregates.

functions.name: create_email_template
functions.description: Create or update an email template with multi-part content and personalization variables.

template_id.description: Existing template ID to update; if omitted, a new template is created.

subject.description: Subject line with optional variable placeholders.

content.description: Template content for different MIME types.

variables.description: Declared variables for validation and editor tooling.

functions.returns: Template metadata including template_id, current version, and validation results.

functions.name: create_audience_segment
functions.description: Create or update an audience segment definition with filters and static recipients.

segment_id.description: Existing segment ID to update; if omitted, a new segment is created.

type.description: Dynamic segments are evaluated at send time; static segments are lists.

value.description: Right-hand side value. For 'between', should be an array of 2 values.

sync_options.description: External synchronization options (e.g., from CRM or data warehouse).

mapping.description: Field mapping from external source to recipient fields.

functions.returns: Segment metadata including segment_id, type, estimated size, and sync status.

functions.name: create_campaign
functions.description: Create a new email campaign tying together sender, template, audience, and scheduling.

sender_id.description: Registered sender identity used for From header.

template_id.description: Template to use for this campaign.

primary_segment_id.description: Primary audience segment for the campaign.

additional_segments.description: Optional additional segments to include or exclude.

end_at.description: Optional end time for sending windowed campaigns.

tracking.description: Tracking and analytics options at campaign level.

functions.returns: Campaign object including campaign_id, scheduling status, and audience size estimate.

functions.name: validate_campaign_readiness
functions.description: Validate that a campaign is ready to send by checking sender, template, audience, and compliance constraints.

sample_variables.description: Sample variable values for rendering template previews.

functions.returns: Validation report including readiness flag, list of issues, and suggested remediations.

functions.name: start_campaign_send
functions.description: Start or schedule sending for a prepared campaign, optionally with throttling and batching options.

override_schedule.description: Override campaign schedule at send time.

burst_limit.description: Max messages in a single burst before backing off.

deduplication.description: Recipient deduplication behavior for this send.

lookback_days.description: For cross-campaign dedupe, how many days back to check.

test_mode.description: Optional test mode to limit actual sends.

limit_recipients.description: Max number of recipients to actually send to in test mode.

override_recipients.description: Optional list of test recipients to send all messages to.

functions.returns: Send initiation result including batch_ids, estimated send count, and current campaign send status.

functions.name: get_send_status
functions.description: Get current send status and progress for a campaign or specific batch.

batch_id.description: Optional batch_id to narrow the query.

include_breakdown.description: Include per-status counts (queued, sent, bounced, etc.).

include_time_series.description: Include time series data of send progress.

functions.returns: Send status including state, progress percentages, per-status counts, and optional time series.

functions.name: get_message_events
functions.description: Fetch engagement and delivery events for messages within a campaign, batch, or by message_id.

recipient_email.description: Filter events for a specific recipient email.

functions.returns: List of message events with timestamps, metadata, and pagination cursor.

functions.name: configure_webhook_subscription
functions.description: Create or update a webhook subscription for email events and campaign lifecycle notifications.

webhook_id.description: Existing webhook ID to update; omitted for new subscriptions.

target_url.description: Destination URL where events will be POSTed.

retry_policy.description: Delivery retry policy for failed webhook requests.

functions.returns: Webhook subscription details including webhook_id, status, and delivery statistics baseline.

functions.name: pause_or_cancel_campaign
functions.description: Pause, resume, or cancel a running or scheduled campaign, with options for batch-level control.
functions.returns: Updated campaign state, affected batches, and counts of messages impacted.

functions.name: retry_failed_deliveries
functions.description: Retry transiently failed or deferred email deliveries for a campaign, batch, or specific recipients.

campaign_id.description: Campaign whose failures should be retried.

batch_id.description: Optional batch to scope the retries.

message_ids.description: Explicit list of message_ids to retry.

failure_types.description: Which types of failures are eligible for retry.

max_retry_attempts.description: Do not retry messages that have already reached this attempt count.

dry_run.description: If true, only report what would be retried without actually sending.

functions.returns: Retry plan and/or execution summary including counts retried, skipped, and reasons.

functions.name: rollback_test_sends
functions.description: Roll back or purge test-mode sends and optionally suppress affected recipients from production campaigns.

campaign_id.description: Campaign that was sent in test mode.

actions.description: What to do with the test messages and recipients.

delete_events.description: Delete event data associated with test sends.

suppress_recipients.description: Add test recipients to a suppression list so they won't be targeted accidentally.

tag_suppression_reason.description: Optional label or reason stored with suppression.

preview_only.description: If true, returns what would be rolled back without applying changes.

functions.returns: Rollback report including affected messages, recipients, and any created suppressions.

functions.name: search_campaigns
functions.description: Faceted search across email campaigns with rich filters, time windows, pagination, and aggregations.

facets.description: Facets to compute alongside the result set.

projection.description: Fields to include in the result objects.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A page of email campaign summaries with facet aggregations, pagination cursor, and optional scoring metadata.

functions.name: bulk_create_campaigns
functions.description: Create multiple email campaigns in a single atomic or best-effort batch with idempotency and partial-commit options.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A bulk-job descriptor with per-item outcomes, created email campaign ids, error reasons for failures, and an aggregate counts summary.

functions.name: bulk_update_campaigns
functions.description: Apply patch-style updates to many email campaigns with optimistic concurrency and partial-failure handling.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-item update outcomes (success/failure with reason), new versions for each email campaign, and a summary of skipped and quarantined items.

functions.name: bulk_archive_campaigns
functions.description: Archive or soft-delete many email campaigns in one call with retention, audit reason, and webhook notification.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-id outcome, new lifecycle state for each email campaign, scheduled purge date if applicable, and a job id for tracking.

functions.name: export_campaigns
functions.description: Export email campaign datasets to an external sink in CSV, JSON, Parquet, or NDJSON with filters and signed-URL delivery.

split_by.description: Field to shard output by, e.g., tenant_id.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: An export job descriptor with job id, estimated row count, signed-URL(s) when applicable, and asynchronous completion event details.

functions.name: import_campaigns
functions.description: Bulk-import email campaign records from a file or staging table with schema mapping, validation, and quarantine handling.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: An import job descriptor with counts of valid, invalid, and quarantined rows, sample error messages, and identifiers of created or updated email campaigns.

functions.name: subscribe_to_campaign_events
functions.description: Register a webhook or message-bus subscription to receive email campaign lifecycle events with filtering and retry policy.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created subscription record with id, secret rotation hint, active state, and an example test-event payload for the email campaign.

functions.name: get_campaign_audit_history
functions.description: Retrieve the immutable audit trail for a email campaign, including who changed what, when, and from which channel.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A chronologically ordered list of audit entries for the email campaign, each with actor, action, before/after diff, source, and optional evidence links.

functions.name: schedule_recurring_campaign_job
functions.description: Create or update a recurring job for email campaigns using cron, ISO interval, or calendar windows with backfill and concurrency controls.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created or updated schedule descriptor with id, next run time, effective cron, and any backfill plan summary for the email campaign action.

functions.name: simulate_campaign_changes
functions.description: Preview the effect of a proposed change to a email campaign without persisting, returning a diff and impact analysis.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A simulation report showing the resulting state of the email campaign, a structured diff, policy-check verdicts, and a quantitative impact estimate (cost, latency, blast radius).

functions.name: request_campaign_approval
functions.description: Create an approval workflow request for a email campaign change, with multi-stage approvers, SLA, and evidence attachments.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: An approval-request descriptor with id, current stage, list of pending approvers, SLA deadlines, and links to the email campaign under change.

functions.name: decide_campaign_approval
functions.description: Record an approver decision (approve, reject, request changes) on a pending email campaign approval request.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

expected_stage.description: Optimistic concurrency check on the approval stage.

functions.returns: The updated approval-request state including new stage, list of completed and pending approvers, and any condition list applied to the email campaign.

functions.name: add_campaign_comment
functions.description: Add a threaded comment, mention, or note to a email campaign for collaboration and case-management context.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The persisted comment record with id, threading info, visibility, mention/notification fan-out summary for the email campaign.

functions.name: upload_campaign_attachment
functions.description: Upload or link a binary attachment (evidence, log bundle, screenshot, contract) to a email campaign with scanning and retention.

inline_data.description: Base64 payload when kind is inline_base64.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created attachment record with id, scan verdicts, signed download URL, checksum, and link to the email campaign.

functions.name: create_campaign_snapshot
functions.description: Capture an immutable point-in-time snapshot of a email campaign (state, configuration, dependencies) for audit or rollback.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A snapshot record with id, size, checksum, encryption metadata, and a reference to the email campaign version captured.

functions.name: restore_campaign_from_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a email campaign from a snapshot with selectable scope, validation pre-checks, and notification on completion.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A restore-operation descriptor with operation id, pre-restore snapshot id, validation results, conflict resolutions applied, and final state of the email campaign.

functions.name: get_campaign_metrics
functions.description: Compute and return KPI/metrics aggregates for email campaigns over a time window with grouping, filters, and percentiles.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A metrics result with aggregate values, percentiles, optional period-over-period deltas, sparkline series per group, and the email campaign domain context.

functions.name: get_campaign_dashboard
functions.description: Return a pre-composed dashboard view for email campaigns combining KPIs, alerts, top offenders, and time series.

personalize_for.description: User id to personalize widgets for.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A dashboard payload with KPI tiles, time-series data, top offenders, active alerts, and personalization metadata for the email campaign context.

functions.name: create_campaign_policy
functions.description: Create or update a policy/rule applied to email campaigns with versioning, scope, and rollout strategy.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created or updated policy record with id, version, rollout plan, scope, and an effective-evaluation summary against current email campaigns.

functions.name: evaluate_campaign_policy
functions.description: Evaluate one or more policies against a email campaign in dry-run, returning per-rule verdicts and proposed actions.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-policy and per-rule verdicts with reasons, trace data, and a list of proposed (or applied, when apply_actions=true) actions against the email campaign.

functions.name: get_campaign_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the upstream and downstream dependency graph for a email campaign including services, devices, tickets, and contracts.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A graph payload (nodes, edges, optional health and metrics) describing dependencies for the email campaign, with depth and direction respected.

functions.name: link_campaign_to_related
functions.description: Create or remove an association between a email campaign and another business object (incident, ticket, contract, asset).

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The resulting association record (or removal confirmation) including direction, relation type, and a snapshot of the related-object summary for the email campaign.

functions.name: assign_campaign_owner
functions.description: Assign or reassign ownership/roles on a email campaign with hand-off rules, watchers, and notification.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The updated assignment roster for the email campaign with effective windows, hand-off receipts, and notification fan-out summary.

functions.name: tag_campaigns
functions.description: Apply, remove, or replace tags and labels on one or more email campaigns, with conflict resolution and audit.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-id tag-application outcomes with final tag sets and counts of added/removed/skipped operations for each email campaign.

functions.name: compare_campaign_versions
functions.description: Produce a structured diff between two versions (or snapshots) of a email campaign with semantic equivalence handling.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A diff document describing added, removed, and changed fields between the two versions of the email campaign, with optional side-by-side rendering.

functions.name: configure_campaign_retry_policy
functions.description: Configure default retry, backoff, and circuit-breaker policy applied to email campaign operations and their downstream actions.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The persisted retry/circuit-breaker policy with id, effective scope, and a summary of email campaign operations that match the new policy.

functions.name: check_campaign_health
functions.description: Run a synthetic health/probe sweep against a email campaign and its critical dependencies and return aggregated health status.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Aggregated health verdict for the email campaign, per-probe results, dependency roll-up, and any alert notifications dispatched.

functions.name: clone_campaign
functions.description: Clone a email campaign into a new instance with selective fields, optional rename, and link-back metadata.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The cloned email campaign record with id, lineage link to the source, and a summary of fields reset, copied, or skipped.

functions.name: generate_campaign_report
functions.description: Generate a formatted email campaign report (executive, operational, compliance) and deliver via email/object storage.

schedule_id.description: When generated by a recurring schedule.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A report-generation receipt with report id, download URL or delivery confirmation, page/sheet count, and the email campaign window covered.

functions.name: escalate_campaign
functions.description: Escalate a email campaign to a higher tier or owner group with reason, severity bump, and watcher fan-out.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The escalation record with new owner/tier, severity, SLA, watchers, and a log of notifications sent for the email campaign.
